# Single Worker releases exports and recovery

- Keep one Cloudflare Worker deployment serving React assets and Hono API; Neon, private R2 and Resend support it. Target invoiceui.humza.website.
- Consult current official provider docs when using integration/deployment APIs. Keep Worker bindings typed and runtime-compatible.
- Export versioned machine-readable business/client/project/service/invoice/payment records plus issued PDFs; test restore into an isolated database with relationships intact.
- Preserve backup/rollback paths, private storage, sender verification and owner authentication. Use privacy-conscious logs and meaningful smoke checks.
- Prepare development and staging work fully. Deploy when the user has requested deployment; do not ask again for authorization already given.
- Confirm unknown chargeable resource choices before provisioning them. Missing credentials block only dependent integration steps.
